exposure: fundal pressure during second stage of labor
outcome: postpartum use of analgesics exceeding five doses
cohort: The cohort consisted of 325 vaginal deliveries involving fundal pressure during the second stage of labor, matched with 325 control vaginal deliveries (including vacuum extraction) during a 3-year period.
finding: Fundal pressure, when administered by trained obstetricians, was not associated with adverse obstetric, maternal, or neonatal outcomes.
gest_age: Not specified for inclusion/exclusion, but groups were matched for gestational age.
